title: NetworkModuleWriteRequest
description: network.module-write-request@1: the request of network.modules.write on OpenVibe.Network. PUT /internal/modules/:namespace/:subject: { data } — the record's new value, validated against the namespace's schema; If-Match names the revision read (412 if it moved). DELETE /internal/modules/:namespace/:subject (204) takes no body. The answer to PUT is modules.module-record@1.
